programme.title: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science (Cornell Engineering) / Bachelor of Arts in Computer Science (Arts & Sciences)
programme.degree: B.S. in Computer Science (College of Engineering, endowed) or B.A. in Computer Science (College of Arts & Sciences, endowed); four years; students apply to a college and affiliate with the CS major
programme.how_found: www.cs.cornell.edu/undergrad -> Bowers programme directory -> Bachelor of Science in Computer Science.
programme.notes: No CS-specific admissions page: english, deadline, tuition and aid come from Cornell's university-wide undergraduate admissions and financial aid pages (owner ruling for US universities).

english.notes: Required for applicants who are not US citizens/permanent residents, not native English speakers and not taught in English for the past four years. Page wording: 'Accepted exams and score requirements to be most competitive in our admissions review process include: TOEFL exams taken prior to January 2026: minimum score of 100 TOEFL exams taken January 2026 or later: minimum score of 5.0, recommended score of 5.5 IELTS, minimum score of 7.5 Duolingo English Test, minimum score of 130 Cambridge C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency, minimum score of 191'. No per-section minimums published.

gpa.notes: No minimum GPA published; Cornell reviews holistically ('when reviewed in context with other application materials—such as GPA, academic rigor...'). SAT or ACT required for first-year applicants (https://admissions.cornell.edu/policies/standardized-testing-policy).

deadline.quote: Application Deadlines Deadline Materials Due January 2 Application; application fee or fee waiver
deadline.notes: Regular Decision; year not printed on the admissions page (current cycle). Other required materials due January 19. Same deadlines for international applicants; international financial-aid (CSS Profile) deadline also 'Regular Decision: January 2, 2027' (https://finaid.cornell.edu/first-year-and-transfer-students-international). Early Decision: November 1.

tuition.notes: Table under the heading 'Undergraduate Estimated Cost of Attendance - 2026-27 Academic Year', tab 'Endowed Colleges' (both CS degrees sit in endowed colleges). CONFLICT on the same page: the panel's mobile title reads 'Undergraduate Estimated Cost of Attendance - 2025-26 Academic Year'; the desktop heading says 2026-27. Mandatory fees $1,024 (student activity $424 + Cornell Health $600).

scholarship_exists.quote: Cornell grants and endowed scholarships are need-based "gift aid" that do not need to be repaid.
scholarship_exists.notes: Need-based only; amounts vary; awarded up to demonstrated need (CSS Profile).

scholarship_international.quote: Cornell meets 100 percent of admitted international undergraduates' demonstrated financial need with annual aid offers that include Cornell grants
scholarship_international.notes: Admission is need-aware for international applicants ('interest in or need for financial aid is one factor amongst many considered'); aid includes grants, work-study and loans depending on income; CSS Profile due with the application (RD: January 2, 2027).
